questions.q: What is the maximum number of recipients allowed in the pilot outreach allowlist?
What is the daily cap for email dispatches in this phase?
How must unconsented or cold scraped customer lists be handled?
questions.a: They are strictly blocked. Sending is only permitted to recipients on the active consent allowlist.

questions.q: What requirement must all outbound email templates meet?
questions.a: They must contain clear unsubscribe instructions or opt-out path links.

questions.q: What happens if a recipient hard-bounces or opt-outs?
questions.a: They are immediately and automatically added to the active suppression registry.

questions.q: What is the retry policy for pilot outreach sending?
Are mock fallbacks allowed when running the live command with --execute-live?
questions.a: No. If credentials are missing, the command must fail hard.

questions.q: Are secrets, tokens, or raw email addresses allowed in the committed code or git-tracked logs?
questions.a: No. They must be completely redacted before output to git-tracked files.

questions.q: How is the pilot outreach authorized by the owner?
questions.a: By passing the manual OWNER_APPROVED_LIVE_TOKEN=pilot_email_action_002 token at runtime.

questions.q: How are responses from recipients classified in this milestone?
questions.a: Into positive reply, negative reply, bounce, no response, and opt-out categories.
